worldcombat.skill.snarl.summary: Push a cone of harsh sound forward: everyone inside takes a hit per bark, and whoever is caught by the first bark loses Sp. Atk. The Rant form keeps scolding bark after bark, so a foe can step out of the cone to dodge the rest; the Bark form is a single heavier shout.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.use.0: Scold a cluster at once and cut the enemy's special output
worldcombat.skill.snarl.use.1: Use repeated barks to force a foe out of the cone
worldcombat.skill.snarl.use.2: Open from range by stripping a special attacker
worldcombat.skill.snarl.description.0: Each bark deals about %1$s damage, %2$s barks in all, one every %3$s s; every enemy in the cone is hit by each bark, and the target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on each hit.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.description.1: A target hit by the first bark loses %1$s Sp. Atk stage(s) and is marked scolded for about %2$s; the Sp. Atk drop stays until cleared or the fight ends, while the scolded mark only tells companions not to keep shouting at the same target first.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.description.2: The cone reaches %1$s blocks and opens %2$s degrees.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.option.on: Rant: three barks in a row, each about x0.62, tighter spacing, a narrower and longer cone and cooldown +6 ticks - the same foes take all three, but they can step out of the cone to dodge the later barks.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.option.off: Bark: a single shout at x1.4 power with a wider cone and the base cooldown - one heavier burst, good for hit-and-run.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.timing: The cone reaches %1$s blocks; windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.growth.0: At level %1$s each bark rises to %2$s power, the Sp. Atk drop to %3$s and the cone to %4$s.
On (Rant): three barks in a row, each about x0.62, tighter spacing, a narrower and longer cone and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (Bark): a single shout at x1.4 power with a wider cone and the base cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.preference.ai.ma: Only commit while a threat is within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher walks into a cluster before opening.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.preference.ai.cl: Only prefer the shout when at least this many enemies sit inside the cone; set 1 to shout on sight.
worldcombat.skill.snarl.preference.ai.sk: On: skip an already scolded target while another un-scolded foe is in range, saving the turn for it. Off: keep shouting at it.
